title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle-vendor-rke2-ubuntu-22.04-kernel-mods
author: Priya Anand
description: Fixes missing kernel module packaging and apt mirror entries for Ubuntu 22.04 in the on-prem airgap offline bundle for RKE2 installs. Customers running RKE2 on Ubuntu 22.04 hit a failure during node bootstrap where required modules (overlay, nb-namespace, br_netfilter) were not available inside the airgapped initramfs and the offline apt mirror lacked kernel headers and DKMS packages for patched kernel builds. This PR: 1) vendors pre-built kernel-module tarballs for supported Ubuntu 22.04 kernels and adds a post-install hook in the installer to load modules before kubelet start, 2) updates the offline apt mirror manifest to include linux-headers, dkms and common build deps for Ubuntu 22.04 LTS images we ship, 3) adds a small helper to the vendor pipeline to rebuild DKMS packages deterministically and fingerprint them for TUF metadata, 4) bumps the rke2 helm chart vendoring to a pinned rke2 v1.26.9 artifact that is known-good with our kernel patches, and 5) includes tests and smoke scripts for k3s/rke2 bootstrap in an airgapped environment. Checklist: - [x] Add kernel module tarballs and hook - [x] Update apt mirror manifest and repodata - [x] Add DKMS rebuild helper + fingerprints - [x] Pin rke2 chart artifact - [x] Integration smoke test under CI matrix - [x] Update docs (installer/airgap readme) Related: ENG-4823 (kernel modules reliability), SUP-1234 (customer report). Notes: this is a targeted hotfix for Ubuntu 22.04; other distros unaffected.
